title: Pest Control Treatment Checklist
subtitle: Residential Pest-Control Treatment: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Pest Control Treatment Checklist covers target pest, activity zone, entry point, treatment location, and contributing condition. The residential pest-service coordinator records Residential Pest-Control Treatment criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Pest Control Treatment Checklist keeps Residential Pest-Control Treatment exceptions visible until the residential pest-service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Pest Control Treatment Checklist at residence, room, exterior perimeter, attic, crawlspace, and occupied area. Document target pest, activity zone, entry point, treatment location, and contributing condition identity before Residential Pest-Control Treatment begins. Compare target pest, activity zone, entry point, treatment location, and contributing condition findings with stated Residential Pest-Control Treatment criteria; route unresolved Residential Pest-Control Treatment issues to licensed or otherwise qualified pest-control reviewer. For Pest Control Treatment Checklist, confirm requirements for Residential Pest-Control Treatment. Ask licensed or otherwise qualified pest-control reviewer to review Residential Pest-Control Treatment conditions beyond the residential pest-service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Residential Pest-Control Treatment, identify responsible parties, residence, room, exterior perimeter, attic, crawlspace, and occupied area, and the linked target pest, activity zone, entry point, treatment location, and contributing condition source.

fields.label: Occupant, pet, sensitive-area, and prior-treatment context

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Pest-Control Treatment facts for target pest, activity zone, entry point, treatment location, and contributing condition; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Residential Pest-Control Treatment inspection checks
items: Activity evidence, count, location, and freshness
Entry, moisture, food, waste, and harborage condition
Device or treatment placement and accessibility
Occupant, child, pet, food, and water exposure boundary
Sanitation, exclusion, and structural action needed

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Use observed Residential Pest-Control Treatment evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Residential Pest-Service Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Target pest cannot be reliably identified
Occupied-area or non-target exposure cannot be controlled
Required preparation or vacancy not completed
Structural or sanitation cause prevents effective treatment
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Pest-Control Treatment when identification, exposure control, required preparation, or a contributing condition remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Pest-Control Treatment proof and route unresolved target pest, activity zone, entry point, treatment location, and contributing condition scope to residential pest-service coordinator.
